teaser: A hallway light gets switched off before anyone else is ready for bed. Life path 7 and INFJ meet in that small act of closing a door, not to shut anyone out, but to hear a thought all the way through. In a hospital waiting room near midnight, the pattern on the floor tiles might hold more attention than the magazine left open on the chair beside you. What does that stillness hold? The compound number behind this path, 16, the total your birth date adds up to before it folds to the single digit seven, carries its own weather, asking what that does to a mind that might go quiet before it opens its mouth.
